SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, sequence_id, order_index, narrative_purpose, retention_role, subjects_json::text AS subjects_json, location_ref, start_state_json::text AS start_state_json, action_json::text AS action_json, end_state_json::text AS end_state_json, composition_json::text AS composition_json, camera_json::text AS camera_json, subject_motion_json::text AS subject_motion_json, camera_motion_json::text AS camera_motion_json, environment_motion_json::text AS environment_motion_json, target_duration_ms, generation_strategy, quality_profile, continuity_from_shot_id, continuity_to_shot_id, status FROM shots WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO shots (row_version, created_at, updated_at, sequence_id, order_index, narrative_purpose, retention_role, subjects_json, location_ref, start_state_json, action_json, end_state_json, composition_json, camera_json, subject_motion_json, camera_motion_json, environment_motion_json, target_duration_ms, generation_strategy, quality_profile, continuity_from_shot_id, continuity_to_shot_id, status) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{sequenceId}, #{orderIndex}, #{narrativePurpose}, #{retentionRole}, COALESCE(#{subjectsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{locationRef}, COALESCE(#{startStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{actionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{endStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{compositionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{cameraJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{subjectMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{cameraMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{environmentMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), #{targetDurationMs}, #{generationStrategy}, #{qualityProfile}, #{continuityFromShotId}, #{continuityToShotId}, #{status}) RETURNING id

(#{s.rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{s.createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{s.updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{s.sequenceId}, #{s.orderIndex}, #{s.narrativePurpose}, #{s.retentionRole}, COALESCE(#{s.subjectsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), #{s.locationRef}, COALESCE(#{s.startStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.actionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.endStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.compositionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.cameraJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.subjectMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.cameraMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{s.environmentMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), #{s.targetDurationMs}, #{s.generationStrategy}, #{s.qualityProfile}, #{s.continuityFromShotId}, #{s.continuityToShotId}, #{s.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE shots SET narrative_purpose = #{narrativePurpose}, retention_role = #{retentionRole}, subjects_json = COALESCE(#{subjectsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), location_ref = #{locationRef}, start_state_json = COALESCE(#{startStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), action_json = COALESCE(#{actionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), end_state_json = COALESCE(#{endStateJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), composition_json = COALESCE(#{compositionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), camera_json = COALESCE(#{cameraJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), subject_motion_json = COALESCE(#{subjectMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), camera_motion_json = COALESCE(#{cameraMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), environment_motion_json = COALESCE(#{environmentMotionJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), target_duration_ms = #{targetDurationMs}, generation_strategy = #{generationStrategy}, quality_profile = #{qualityProfile}, continuity_from_shot_id = #{continuityFromShotId}, continuity_to_shot_id = #{continuityToShotId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}

mapper.select: SELECT sh.id, sh.row_version, sh.created_at, sh.updated_at, sh.sequence_id, sh.order_index, sh.narrative_purpose, sh.retention_role, sh.subjects_json::text AS subjects_json, sh.location_ref, sh.start_state_json::text AS start_state_json, sh.action_json::text AS action_json, sh.end_state_json::text AS end_state_json, sh.composition_json::text AS composition_json, sh.camera_json::text AS camera_json, sh.subject_motion_json::text AS subject_motion_json, sh.camera_motion_json::text AS camera_motion_json, sh.environment_motion_json::text AS environment_motion_json, sh.target_duration_ms, sh.generation_strategy, sh.quality_profile, sh.continuity_from_shot_id, sh.continuity_to_shot_id, sh.status FROM shots sh JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.id = sh.sequence_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND ch.id = #{chapterId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sc.storyboard_revision_id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id ORDER BY sc.order_index ASC, vb.order_index ASC, sh.order_index ASC

SELECT sh.id, sh.row_version, sh.created_at, sh.updated_at, sh.sequence_id, sh.order_index, sh.narrative_purpose, sh.retention_role, sh.subjects_json::text AS subjects_json, sh.location_ref, sh.start_state_json::text AS start_state_json, sh.action_json::text AS action_json, sh.end_state_json::text AS end_state_json, sh.composition_json::text AS composition_json, sh.camera_json::text AS camera_json, sh.subject_motion_json::text AS subject_motion_json, sh.camera_motion_json::text AS camera_motion_json, sh.environment_motion_json::text AS environment_motion_json, sh.target_duration_ms, sh.generation_strategy, sh.quality_profile, sh.continuity_from_shot_id, sh.continuity_to_shot_id, sh.status FROM shots sh JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.id = sh.sequence_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND sh.id = #{shotId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sc.chapter_id FROM shots sh JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.id = sh.sequence_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND sh.id = #{shotId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sq.id, sq.row_version, sq.created_at, sq.updated_at, sq.visual_beat_id, sq.order_index FROM shot_sequences sq JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id WHERE sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND sq.visual_beat_id = #{visualBeatId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'sourceLanguage', project.source_language, 'narrationLanguage', project.narration_language, 'imageAspectRatio', CASE project.image_aspect_ratio WHEN 'RATIO_16_9' THEN '16:9' WHEN 'RATIO_9_16' THEN '9:16' WHEN 'RATIO_1_1' THEN '1:1' WHEN 'RATIO_4_3' THEN '4:3' WHEN 'RATIO_3_4' THEN '3:4' ELSE project.image_aspect_ratio END, 'aspectRatioOverride', vb.aspect_ratio_override, 'projectId', sc.project_id, 'chapterId', ch.id, 'storyVersionId', ch.story_version_id, 'chapterRowVersion', ch.row_version, 'sourceHash', ch.source_hash, 'sourceText', ch.source_text, 'storyboardRevisionId', sc.storyboard_revision_id, 'visualBeatId', vb.id, 'visualBeatReviewStatus', vb.review_status, 'shotRowVersion', sh.row_version, 'subjects', sh.subjects_json, 'shot', to_jsonb(sh) - 'created_at' - 'updated_at' - 'status', 'cues', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ac) ORDER BY ac.order_index, ac.id) FROM audio_cues ac WHERE ac.story_beat_id = vb.story_beat_id), '[]'::jsonb), 'characters', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'projectCharacterId', pc.id, 'characterId', pc.character_id, 'characterVersionId', cv.id, 'versionNumber', cv.version_number, 'status', cv.status, 'bible', cv.bible, 'visualPrompt', cv.visual_prompt) ORDER BY pc.id) FROM project_characters pc LEFT JOIN character_versions cv ON cv.id = pc.pinned_character_version_id AND cv.character_id = pc.character_id WHERE pc.project_id = #{projectId} AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visual_beat_characters vc WHERE vc.visual_beat_id = vb.id AND vc.project_character_id = pc.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scene_characters scene_participant WHERE scene_participant.scene_id = sc.id AND scene_participant.project_character_id = pc.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audio_cues ac WHERE ac.story_beat_id = vb.story_beat_id AND ac.speaker_project_character_id = pc.id))), '[]'::jsonb) )::text FROM shots sh JOIN shot_sequences sq ON sq.id = sh.sequence_id JOIN visual_beats vb ON vb.id = sq.visual_beat_id JOIN scenes sc ON sc.id = vb.scene_id JOIN chapters ch ON ch.id = sc.chapter_id JOIN projects project ON project.id = sc.project_id AND project.archived_at IS NULL WHERE sh.id = #{shotId} AND sc.project_id = #{projectId} AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL AND sc.storyboard_revision_id = ch.current_storyboard_revision_id FOR UPDATE OF sh, ch
